u_0 = 6.761 	imes 10^{14}\) Hz and \(\lambda_0 = 4438\ \mathring{A}\), and both are inconsistent with the key's OWN \(h\) and \(\phi\). The threshold frequency is fixed by \(
u_0 = \phi/h\); with the key's own \(\phi = 2.801\) eV \(= 4.482 	imes 10^{-19}\) J and \(h = 6.427 	imes 10^{-34}\) J s that is \(6.973 	imes 10^{14}\) Hz, whence \(\lambda_0 = c/
u_0 = 4302\ \mathring{A}\). Run backwards, the printed \(6.761 	imes 10^{14}\) Hz would require \(\phi = 2.716\) eV, which the same key does not print. The error propagates into \(\lambda_0\), since \(4438\ \mathring{A}\) is exactly \(c\) divided by the wrong frequency. The key's \(h\) and \(\phi\) agree with our derivation.]
